name: cal_3x10_v4_railtest
notes: DIAGNOSTIC PROFILE — NOT FOR CAPTURE. This is the exact cell geometry of the cal_3x10_v4 that latched on fw v4.34 (session_20260810_174641.csv, profile_sha8 69d51733), preserved so the v4.35 outlier-gate fix has a reproducible regression case. Cells 0/1 of every band sit INSIDE ADC saturation (8191 codes / 4999389 uV, positive full scale) and that is deliberate — railing those cells is the condition under test. On fw v4.34 cells 0-3 of every band bar ch20 froze bit-identical within ~20 s and never recovered; on v4.35 every channel must keep changing. NEVER capture a corpus against this profile: the railed cells report limits, not measurements, and the name is deliberately distinct from cal_3x10_v4 so the pimd_features cross-epoch guard cannot conflate the two geometries (DESIGN §10). The operating profile is cal_3x10_v4, whose early cells were re-cut out of saturation on 2026-08-10. threshold_v is a placeholder ordering key only, carried over unchanged.
